correctness.rationale: For two words of composition \(\llbracket1,\ldots,1\rrbracket\), if their supports intersect in \(r\) coordinates and agree in symbol on \(t\) of them, then \(d_H=2w-r-t\). Distance at least \(2w-1\) forces \(r+t\le1\), so supports meet at most once and no nonzero symbol repeats at a coordinate. Thus each coordinate is used by at most \(w\) words and incidence counting gives \(|C|\le n\). At equality, all point and block degrees are \(w\), producing a symmetric configuration \(n_w\); the symbols form a proper \(w\)-edge-coloring of its Levi graph. Conversely, König's line-coloring theorem gives such an edge-coloring for every \(w\)-regular bipartite Levi graph, and the resulting code has distance \(2w\) or \(2w-1\). The published \(n_6\) spectrum then gives equality exactly at \(n=31\) or \(n\ge34\), hence the threshold \(34\).
residual_risks: The historical exhaustive nonexistence proof for the \(33_6\) configuration is used as a published input rather than re-executed.
